versions.description: Initial picks selector (Phase 2). Four-bucket priority-fill (cap 20 unique groups/day): leaders = 8 sustained_strength (lowest sum of rank_month+rank_quarter+rank_half) + 2 freshness fills (momentum_confirmed desc, not already in core); emerging = regime_short_long > 0.15 AND rs_score > 0.5 (sort regime_short_long desc); accel = momentum_accel > 0.08 AND top-40% by momentum_score AND rs_score > 0.5 (sort momentum_accel desc); rs_new_high = rs_new_high == 1 AND rs_score >= 0.6 AND top-40% by momentum_score (sort rs_slope desc). Anti-flash floor is a cross-sectional momentum_score percentile (top 40%), invariant to formula rescaling. VP-locked 2026-06-24/25; see ADR-007.
